q: The Hénon map (x,y) ↦ (1 − ax² + y, bx) is a benchmark chaotic map. For the parameter values a=1.4, b=0.3 it has a strange attractor with Hausdorff dimension approximately:
exp: The Hénon attractor for a=1.4, b=0.3 has Hausdorff dimension ≈ 1.261 (estimated numerically). The attractor is 'thin' in one direction (contracting, b=0.3 gives |Jac|=b<1) and has fractal structure in the other, giving dimension between 1 and 2.
